quizzes.stem: Why is 0 ÷ 0 undefined in real-number division?

options.A: No real x can satisfy 0 × x = 0.

quizzes.explanation: Every real x satisfies 0 × x = 0, so there is no unique quotient. For a nonzero numerator, 0 × x = a has no solution instead.

distractor_feedback.A: Every real x satisfies that equation.
distractor_feedback.B: Zero is one of many solutions, not a unique quotient.
distractor_feedback.D: One is one of many solutions, not a unique quotient.

quizzes.objective: Distinguish no solution from no unique division result.
